🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Etsy SEO has changed and if you’re still treating Etsy search as simply “put your keywords in the title”, you’re missing a lot. Etsy is increasingly using AI to understand what shoppers are searching for and what your listings actually contain. That means things like your attributes, tags, listing images and the information surrounding your product can all help Etsy understand where your listing belongs. In this video I go through 5 Etsy SEO and listing optimisation tips that I think a lot of sellers overlook including one involving your listing images and alt text that can also help Google understand your products. I also show you why you shouldn't just repeat the same keyword across all 13 tags, and how Etsy Marketplace Insights can give you actual search data to find new keyword opportunities. If you sell on Etsy and you're trying to get more views on your listings, these are the sorts of things I'd be looking at before blindly rewriting hundreds of titles. And that's basically what The Messy Seller is about: digging into the stuff behind Etsy search, testing what actually makes sense, and separating useful Etsy SEO from the advice that just gets repeated because someone said it once. If you're an Etsy seller, save this one especially if you've got a big catalogue of listings to optimise. #Etsy #EtsySeller #EtsySEO #EtsyTips #EtsySellertips
